title: Feeling That It Has Touched: A Torque Residual, a Threshold Above the Model's Error, and a Count of Ticks Before Believing It

artifact.note: contact detection from the joint torque: the residual between the torque measured (from the motor current) and the torque the model says the free motion needs (gravity, friction, inertia), a low pass filter on it, a threshold that has to be above what the model gets wrong and the noise, and a count of ticks the residual must stay over it before contact is believed; tested on a single joint driven into a wall, for how soon contact was found, what the wall's force was by then, and what a low threshold does in free motion
